specification.name: NCTD Manifest Parser

extends.rule: All v2.10.0 rules remain active. This version adds the NCTD prefix to Tobi MRN and to the passenger catalog MRNs.

specification.description: v2.11.0 overlay: Tobi MRN starts with NCTD (Client ID 1365 gives NCTD1365, NCTD1365PCA, NCTD1365COM). Catalog MRNs without the prefix are migrated: in memory by the App, and once in DynamoDB with scripts/migrate-mrn-prefix.js.

changes: MRN-PREFIX-001: Tobi MRN = NCTD + the previous value: NCTD1365 (CLI), NCTD1365PCA (PCA), NCTD1365COM (COM and COMP). A Client ID that already starts with NCTD does not get the prefix twice (decision 2026-11-19).
Vendor ID, Leg ID, Leg ID V2, Pair Status and pairing do not change: they keep the Client ID without prefix.

CATALOG-MRN-PREFIX-MIGRATION-001: a catalog MRN Number without the prefix gets it (1365 becomes NCTD1365), so known passengers keep matching and are not created again. The updated Pasajeros CSV keeps the new value; the summary counts the changes.

In database mode the App matches items still without prefix as if they had it and shows CATALOG_MRN_PREFIX_PENDING; it does not rewrite keys. The table keys (mrn) and mrnNumber are migrated once with scripts/migrate-mrn-prefix.js (dry run by default, backup file, atomic move per passenger, idempotent).
Added acceptance tests AT-80 to AT-84.

tobi_mrn.prefix_idempotency: Added once: a Client ID that already starts with NCTD (letters and digits, case-insensitive) is not prefixed again.
tobi_mrn.applies_to: Only Tobi MRN and the catalog MRN Number. Vendor ID, Leg ID, Leg ID V2 and pairing keep the Client ID without prefix.

key.prefix: Catalog MRNs carry the same NCTD prefix as Tobi MRN (NCTD82475PCA).

mrn_prefix_migration.applies_to: MRN Number values (catalog CSV rows and database items) that do not start with the prefix.
mrn_prefix_migration.action: Add the prefix in front of the stored value (1365 becomes NCTD1365, 82475_PCA becomes NCTD82475_PCA). Names, phone and order do not change.
mrn_prefix_migration.csv_mode: Applied when the Pasajeros CSV is read; the updated CSV keeps the prefixed value. Summary field catalogMrnPrefixed.
mrn_prefix_migration.database_mode: The App matches unprefixed items as if they had the prefix, without writing, and reports CATALOG_MRN_PREFIX_PENDING with the number of items. The table is migrated once per table with scripts/migrate-mrn-prefix.js.

migration_script.default: Dry run: lists what would change and writes nothing.
migration_script.apply: --apply writes a JSON backup of every item to backups/, then moves each passenger in one transaction: Put the new item (mrn = NCTD + old key, mrnNumber with prefix, other attributes unchanged) only if it does not exist, and Delete the old item only if it is unchanged.
migration_script.already_moved: If the new key already exists with the same names and phone, only the old item is deleted; if they differ, both are kept and reported for review.
migration_script.untouched: The #LEG_ID_V2_SEQ counter and items that already have the prefix.
migration_script.safety: --table must name the table in CATALOG_TABLE; production needs --table nctd-passengers-prod explicitly.
migration_script.permissions: Scan, PutItem and DeleteItem on the table. DeleteItem is added to the IAM policy only for the migration and removed afterwards.

expected_transforms.Tobi MRN: Baseline TC expected Tobi MRN values are compared with the NCTD prefix (field_rules.tobi_mrn.prefix) in front.

acceptance_tests_patch.case: Client ID 1365 as CLI, PCA, COM and COMP; Client ID 82-475; Client ID NCTD1365
acceptance_tests_patch.expected: Tobi MRN NCTD1365, NCTD1365PCA, NCTD1365COM, NCTD1365COM, NCTD82475, NCTD1365; Vendor ID, Leg ID and Leg ID V2 unchanged

acceptance_tests_patch.case: Pasajeros CSV with MRN Number 1365, 1365PCA and NCTD2002
acceptance_tests_patch.expected: Known passengers match; the updated CSV has NCTD1365 and NCTD1365PCA; catalogMrnPrefixed = 2; processing the result again changes nothing

acceptance_tests_patch.case: Database with items 1365 and 1365PCA not yet migrated
acceptance_tests_patch.expected: Passengers match with their stored values; nothing new to save; CATALOG_MRN_PREFIX_PENDING (warning) with count 2; the table is not written
Dry run writes nothing; --apply moves each passenger to mrn NCTD..., keeps names, phone, addedAt, ord and source, leaves the counter alone and writes a backup; a second run changes nothing

acceptance_tests_patch.case: Migration when the prefixed item already exists
acceptance_tests_patch.expected: Same names and phone: the old item is deleted; different: both are kept and reported

consistency_contract_patch.acceptance_test_id_range: AT-01..AT-84 with no gaps after applying v2.5.0 to v2.11.0
